description:

Are you as good as your reputation?

Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission with accelerators for overperformance.

title: Accountmanager New Business
AI Marketing Traineeship
description:
Heb je er wel eens aan gedacht om in een van de snelst groeiende industrieën ter wereld te werken?

Misschien wel. Maar wat als je nog geen jaren ervaring hebt? Voor ON2IT maakt dat niet uit.

Wij selecteren op intrinsieke motivatie en aanleg. We zoeken mensen die gedreven zijn om de digitale wereld veiliger te maken, die denken in systemen, en die niet stoppen totdat ze iets snappen. Mensen die van nature de vraag stellen: kan AI dit slimmer?

Wij helpen je de top 10% te worden van AI-native marketeers in cybersecurity.

Hoe? Maak kennis met ons AI Marketing Traineeship.

Wat je kunt verwachten

Wat ga je doen?

Je bouwt de ON2IT marketingmachine van de toekomst. Niet als toeschouwer, maar als bouwer. Je werkt AI-first aan content, campagnes, events en automatiseringen. Je leert niet eerst twee jaar meedraaien voordat je iets mag. Je levert af vanaf dag een.

Hoe is het traineeship opgebouwd?

Je doorloopt drie niveaus. Jij bepaalt het tempo. Er zijn geen vaste maanden aan elk niveau gekoppeld. Je stroomt door wanneer je het kunt aantonen.

Niveau 1: Uitvoerder

Je leert ON2IT kennen: onze klanten, onze toon, onze positie in de markt. Je schrijft je eerste LinkedIn-posts via Claude, genereert beelden via Claude, Adobe Firefly of Canva, en bouwt mee aan de prompt-bibliotheek die ON2IT marketing draaiende houdt. Je beoordeelt AI-output kritisch op merkwaarde.

Niveau 2: Orkestreerder

Je bouwt workflows die taken automatiseren. Een campagne van briefing tot publicatie, volledig gedocumenteerd en herhaalbaar. Je trekt een event van A tot Z. Je prompt-bibliotheek groeit en verbetert. Elke maand presenteer je aan het team wat je hebt gebouwd en wat het oplevert.

Niveau 3: Strateeg

Je evalueert het marketing-systeem als geheel. Je signaleert wat ontbreekt en bouwt het, zonder dat iemand je erom vraagt. Je draagt je kennis over aan collega's en bent sparringpartner voor de Marketing Manager op campagne- en contentstrategie.

Hoe lang duurt het traineeship?

12 maanden. Op maand 6 is er een tussentijdse evaluatie. Op maand 12 volgt de formalisering van je vaste aanstelling.

Wat bieden wij je?

Naast een echte instap in de wereld van AI-first marketing bieden wij:

• Salaris: € 2.600 bruto per maand tijdens het traineeship

• Perspectief: Vaste aanstelling als allround AI-native marketeer na 12 maanden

• Begeleiding: Wekelijkse 1:1 met de Marketing Manager. Jij stuurt de agenda.

• Verantwoordelijkheid: Echte projecten, geen stageprojecten

• Leren: Certificeringen via HubSpot Academy en Frankwatching, Canva Pro licentie

• Locatie: Zaltbommel (NL) met mogelijkheid tot hybride werken

Wat maakt dit traineeship anders dan een gewone functie?

Dit traineeship is ontworpen voor mensen die de top 10% willen worden in AI-native marketing. Jouw ontwikkeling is onze prioriteit. Je wordt omringd door experts in cybersecurity en marketing, en je werkt dagelijks met de nieuwste AI-tools als standaard werkwijze, niet als experiment.

Wat voor iemand ben jij?

We vragen geen vijf jaar ervaring. We vragen aanleg, leergierigheid, en de bereidheid om anders te denken dan je bent opgeleid.

Je herkent jezelf hierin:

• Je denkt in systemen, niet in taken

• Je vraagt bij elke klus: kan AI dit?

• Je levert af zonder dat iemand aan je trekt

• Je snapt dat toon en merkidentiteit ertoe doen

• Je bent nieuwsgierig naar cybersecurity als vakgebied

• Je durft een eigen mening te verdedigen

• Je bent rustig onder druk en werkt gestructureerd

Dit helpt mee:

• HBO of WO richting communicatie, marketing of aanverwant vakgebied

• Ervaring met AI-tools (Claude, ChatGPT of vergelijkbaar)

• Affiniteit met B2B of technologie

• Je schrijft scherp en foutloos Nederlands

• Engels op professioneel niveau

Wat komt er na het traineeship?

Je hebt het traineeship afgerond en de eerste 12 maanden achter de rug. Wat volgt er?

Je treedt in vaste dienst als allround AI-native marketeer. Afhankelijk van je groei en interesses zijn er meerdere richtingen mogelijk:

• Verdieping in campagnestrategie en B2B marketing

• Specialisatie in AI-automatisering en workflow-architectuur

• Groei naar een seniorfunctie binnen het marketingteam

• Certificeringen in gevorderde AI-tooling en marketingplatforms

Belangrijk: er zit geen plafond op je ontwikkeling. Wij willen jou zien groeien naar de top 10%.

Praktische criteria

Kort samengevat. Om deel te kunnen nemen aan dit traineeship, moet je aan de volgende voorwaarden voldoen:

• Je beschikt over een Europees paspoort voor de veiligheidsscreening

• Je woont op maximaal 45 minuten reisafstand van ons kantoor in Zaltbommel

• Je bent beschikbaar voor 40 uur per week

• Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en professioneel Engels

Wil je de top 10% worden?

Geweldig. Solliciteer of stuur een bericht naar Karin Muller (Marketing Manager) om je enthousiasme te laten zien met:

• Je CV

• Een korte motivatie: waarom ON2IT, waarom nu, en wat maakt jou de juiste persoon voor dit traineeship

• Een voorbeeld van iets wat je hebt gemaakt: een tekst, een video, een campagne, een automatisering, een prompt. Iets concreets.

WIE ZIJN WIJ?

ON2IT is een internationale cybersecurity organisatie met Nederlandse roots. In 2005 opgericht door Lieuwe Jan Koning en Marcel van Eemeren. Vandaag beschermen we meer dan 300 klanten wereldwijd en groeien we harder dan ooit.

Meer dan 20 jaar ervaring heeft ons geleerd dat cybersecurity niet one-size-fits-all is. Wij bouwen Zero Trust, niet als modewoord, maar als fundament. Terwijl de rest van de wereld achter incidenten aanrent, voorkomen wij ze.

Het ON2IT-team bestaat uit mensen die ergens voor staan. Persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat centraal. We streven ernaar de beste te zijn in IT-security.

Dit jaar groeien we harder dan ooit. Doe jij mee?

ON2IT. Zero Trust. AI-First. Niet braaf. Kom bouwen.

title: CTI Specialist
Inside Sales
description:
Note: for this position it is needed to speak, write and read in Dutch!

Would you like to strengthen our Inside Sales Team?

Join the forefront of cybersecurity at ON2IT, a dynamic force in the cybersecurity industry. We're passionate about protecting businesses and individuals from evolving cyber threats, pioneering innovative solutions to secure the digital landscape: prevention first! Do you have a passion for finding the perfect solution for customers and are you ready to play a key role in the dynamic field of cybersecurity? Then this is your chance to be part of our dedicated Inside Sales Team at ON2IT.

What will you do as our Inside Sales Hero/Heroine?

You will be the link between customer inquiries and the right solutions. Together with our sales managers, you will serve both the public sector (think hospitals and municipalities) and commercial companies. Together, you will forge plans to approach new businesses, whether it's cold acquisition, warm leads, or existing customers. No day is the same!

You are the face of our company to our customers and thrive on maintaining daily contacts. With your fresh ideas and initiative, you exceed customer expectations, together with your colleagues.

You are responsible for preparing and processing quotations, relationship management, and contract renewals. You also ensure that our sales managers are informed of your activities and proactively gather the information you need. Additionally, we expect you to delve into cybersecurity so that you can explain what we do at a whiteboard level.

But that's not all! Together with us, you want to grow and continue to develop yourself. In collaboration with our marketing department, you prepare actions and events and ensure that our sales managers are well-prepared for customer appointments. You are ready to help people and enthusiastically answer customer questions.

About you

You already have experience in Inside Sales, whether you're a junior or a mid-level professional. You excel at organizing your work and meeting tight deadlines. Naturally, you have an affinity for IT or cybersecurity. You are driven to be the best and always open to learning and diving into new challenges

Your administration is always in order! You are communicative, accurate, and always manage to maintain control of your work in ON2IT's dynamic environment. You are proficient in both written and spoken Dutch and English. Your educational and professional level is at HBO level.

About us

Our Sales department is a fun and enthusiastic group, and we have a diverse portfolio of clients. This requires qualities such as agility and creativity. Be prepared for a dynamic and challenging environment!

"Never trust, always verify." At ON2IT Cybersecurity, we work according to the Zero Trust strategy to help our customers prevent data breaches. If for any reason there is still a (international) leak, we guarantee to inform our customers within minutes about the cause, which data has been affected, and whether the problem has been resolved. Everything we do is focused on the safety of the customer, and we do this with passion. We work with customers in sectors including retail, healthcare, finance, and government.

We are an ambitious global player in cybersecurity in both Europe and North America. With our ambition, we lead the way in Zero Trust, innovation, and solutions. We have an informal and open culture, and you will work with colleagues who inspire each other every day. Together, we are building an even brighter future.

We offer a challenging position (32-40 hours) at the best cybersecurity organization in the Netherlands. You will have a lot of autonomy and trust, with a high degree of freedom in how you carry out your work.

You will have plenty of opportunities to continue developing yourself by following training and courses. Every afternoon, an extensive and well-prepared lunch awaits you at the office. Additionally, you will receive:

• 24 vacation days per year, with the possibility to buy extra days.

• Mobility allowance.

• Opportunities to work from home (1 or 2 days per week).

• A good pension scheme.

• Growth opportunities.

• Unlimited Learning: unlimited access to training and courses.

Are you ready to take your career to new heights in a stimulating and innovative environment?

If you want to know more about the role and the department, you can also call your future manager, Maurice Schiffer, at +31 (0)6 53 37 29 89.

We look forward to welcoming you to our team of cybersecurity heroes!

title: Senior PHP/Go Developer
description:
In today’s world, cybersecurity is an integral part of everyday life. Companies need to be prepared for anything; at any moment a threatening situation can arise. Together with your colleagues (currently 8 developers and testers), you build small projects in containers. Those projects together form the software solution on which ON2IT’s entire business runs. We mainly use PHP and Go, but it doesn’t actually matter which language you use. As long as it works and is simple. Keep it simple, fail fast.

And we have hefty demands of our own work quality, so we have CI and CD fully set up. Code styling is automatically checked and corrected, security checks are performed and of course our unit tests and functional tests (Cypress and Codeception) run before we roll out. You put your changes into production yourself after a code review and functional test.

What you tell others you’re doing:

I build software that keeps our customers from getting hacked. Cybersecurity, yes, something with computers. No, that doesn’t mean I can fix your printer.

What will your work week look like:

As expected, you will mostly be writing code, which you will be doing from home and, at least 2 days a week, from our Zaltbommel office. We start the day with a (remote) stand up. There, we discuss the progress of the work. Do you need help? There are always colleagues ready to help you. The work consists of fixing bugs and implementing small feature requests or new projects. We record all these things in Gitlab. Sometime around noon, we have lunch together (unless you work from home of course) in our cozy canteen. Everything is completely taken care of; we just ask you to put away your plate in the dishwasher after. Every two weeks, we have a general team meeting and we do a retrospective as a team, that way we keep improving.

Is this you?

- You have excellent knowledge of PHP, Go, Java, Python or a similar language;

- You have a completed IT degree or you have demonstrable college level of thinking and working;

- In your code, you don’t risk an XSS exploit. Never.

What do we offer you?

We offer ample opportunity to continue to develop yourself by aiding you in furthering your education and encouraging you to follow training courses. A varied and well catered lunch will be available at the office every afternoon.

You will also receive:

- 24 vacation days, with the possibility to buy extra

- Mobility allowance

- Opportunities to work from home

- Advancement opportunities

- Unlimited learning: access to training and education

What does our job application procedure look like?

Have we managed to excite you about this job? Then we look forward to receiving your application! You can apply by clicking the button below.

This application process involves two rounds of interviews and an assessment. After this, we discuss the terms of employment in a separate interview. Positive completion of a screening is part of your onboarding.

If you have any questions about the procedure, contact our HR team: 088-2266200.

title: SOC Cyber Security Specialist
description:
THE ROLE

Our customers trust us to keep their networks out of the news. You are the person who makes that true.

You analyze what is really happening on a customer's network, decide what matters, and configure the controls that stop the next attempt. You work in our Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) in Zaltbommel, part of a global team that runs 24x7. One shift you untangle a routing problem; on another you segment a customer's network into Protect Surfaces and tune the policy that guards them. Always with prevention as the goal: we stop the incident, not just report it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Analyze anomalies, alerts and threats, and decide what is real

- Fix security issues in routing and networks

- Configure security controls along Zero Trust principles

- Work hands-on with protocols like SSH, SSL, HTTPS, SMTP and DHCP

- Document your work so the next colleague hits the ground running

- Advise customers and colleagues, and make complex things simple

WORKING IN SHIFTS

Our SOC does not close.

We work in shifts to ensure 24/7 security for our customers, alongside colleagues in Europe and the US. You will work a rotating pattern:

- Two morning shifts (06:00 - 14:30)

- Two afternoon shifts (14:00 - 22:30)

- Two night shifts (22:00 - 06:30)

- Followed by 4 days off

HOW WE WORK WITH AI

AI is built into our service, not bolted on: MDR Detect runs AI-assisted case handling behind our 24x7 human-led GSOC. We also build our own bespoke AI tooling on top of our platform, and the specialists who use it help shape it.

We expect you to understand prompting (structure and context change the answer), reuse (turn a repeated prompt into a skill), verification (a model can be confident and wrong) and privacy (know what goes into which tool). Not an expert yet? Curious and honest about the gaps is what matters.

WHO YOU ARE

- You pull the thread until you understand it

- You can say "I don't know yet" and then go find out

- You care about doing it properly: a sloppy investigation is worse than none

- You can explain a technical problem without making anyone feel stupid

WHAT YOU BRING

Technical Foundation

- Networking at CCNA level

- Concepts network segmentation, VPN, NAT, DNS and certificates

- Security thinking least privilege, defense in depth, and how an attack moves once inside

- Systems Windows, macOS and Linux

- Protocols the common ones (SSH, SSL, HTTPS, SMTP, DHCP), and the confidence to pick up the rest

- Certifications willing to get them. We pay, you study

Ways of working

- You use AI daily and can explain how, not just that you do

- You can use git (clone, branch, commit, merge request) and write Markdown: our runbooks and AI context live in plain text under version control. This is not a developer role

- You respect confidentiality: customer data does not go just anywhere

The rest

- Excellent English, spoken and written

- Willing to join a 24x7 shift rotation

- On-site: this is not a hybrid role, and you live within ~50 minutes of Zaltbommel

- Pre-employment screening, due to the sensitive nature of the job

Nice to have: experience with Palo Alto Strata or Cortex, Microsoft Defender or Fortinet FortiGate; SOC, NOC or managed services experience; Dutch; Python, Bash or similar scripting.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will grow fast, because we make sure of it.

- A clear path Junior to Medior to Senior, with explicit criteria for each step

- Cutting-edge technology for customers all over the world; no two environments are the same

- Colleagues who teach and unlimited learning: training, certification and the time to do it

- 24 vacation days (option to buy more), mobility allowance, shift compensation, catered lunch

Our customers are hospitals, research labs, retailers, banks and manufacturers. When you catch something early, their operation keeps running and the people who depend on it never notice anything happened. That is the point of the job.

Want to join the team? Apply now.

title: Traineeship Cybersecurity
description:
Have you ever thought about working in one of the fastest growing industries in the world?

You may have, but what if you don’t have qualifications? For ON2IT, it doesn’t matter.

We hire our people on intrinsic motivation for cybersecurity. We're looking for people who are genuinely driven to make the digital world safer. People who are curious about how a digital network works (and how they can be improved), who think like a hacker, and who won’t stop until they’ve figured things out.

We will help you become the top 10%.

How do we do this? Get ready for our Cybersecurity Traineeship.

What to expect: Our traineeship is a training program, where you will start working in our SOC. We have experts in our SOC who will support you in learning and obtaining various certificates. Cases enter our SOC via our own eventflow. Our SOC Specialists investigate these cases to protect the environment of our customers. You will learn how to recognize and detect threats and how to protect and guide our customers.

We will guide you with various trainings. This does not only include technical trainings. As customer contact is an important aspect of the role, we also offer trainings focused on improving your soft-skills.

The duration: 1 year

The working hours: Our SOC works in shifts to ensure 24/7 security for our customers.
This means you’ll work in rotating shifts:
- Two morning shifts (06:00 - 14:30)
- Two afternoon shifts (14:00 - 22:30)
- Two night shifts (22:00 - 06:30)
- Followed by 4 days off

What do we offer you? Besides an entry opportunity to become an expert SOC Engineer, we offer you a total starting package of € 3.750,00. Depending on the obtained certifications, this can be increased by € 400,00 within the first year.

What distinguishes our traineeship from a regular position? Our traineeship is designed for people who want to become the top 10% in Cybersecurity. This means that your development is our top priority. We have an unlimited development budget and you'll be surrounded by top experts in cybersecurity who are eager to share their knowledge.

Are there any prerequisites? You hold an European passport to pass the security screening and you have a driver’s license and the possession of a car (because public transport isn’t sufficient for the shift times).

Can I study for CCNA while applying? Yes. You don’t have to have your CCNA-certificate at the moment you apply. But you have to obtain it before you start in the traineeship.

What kind of person thrives in this traineeship? People who are:
